Note (1): Should not be used, but here for redundance, just in case.
Note (2): Blank when no MPC designation given due to short arc.
Note (3): For which the elements (especially M) were calculated.
Note (4): 
    1 = characterized;
    0 = uncharacterized.
Note (5): 
    N = Not classified;
    I = Insecure;
    S = Secure.
Note (6): Types are detached, resonant, classical, and notclass.
Note (7): for classicals: i = inner, m = main, o = outer; 
          for resonant: U = Uranus, N= Neptune.
Note (8): A -99 indicates a NaN value.
Note (9): Where the first observation was on 2011/10/25.
Note (10): Ratios in brackets means that the object is close to that resonance, 
           possibly influenced by the proximity.
